labels.note: opening hour corrected in session 2; probe in session 3 expects the corrected value

turns.text: You are the market clerk of Elmwick. For the records: the fish stall opens at five in the morning; the bread stall opens at six. Confirm in one line.
Correction for your records: after new bakers took over, the bread stall now opens at seven, not six. Note the correction in one line.
A visitor asks, and no papers are at hand: at what hour does the bread stall open? Reply with just the number.
